brian thomas.name: Brian Thomas Jr.
brian thomas.preseason_stats: 7 rec, 134 yds, 1 TD on 9 targets (92% snap rate with 1st team)
brian thomas.camp_buzz_blurb: Thomas has completely taken over Jacksonville's training camp and preseason games. Trevor Lawrence targeted him on 38% of his dropbacks in Preseason Week 2 and 3, resulting in two 40+ yard receptions and a highlight-reel endzone fade. Head coach Doug Pederson confirmed Thomas will play every snap as the primary perimeter X receiver. Draft steal at ESPN #96 vs consensus #76 (+20 value).
brian thomas.draft_strategy: Target in Rounds 6-7 as an explosive WR2 with Top-15 overall upside.

cam ward.name: Cam Ward
cam ward.preseason_stats: 24/31 (77.4%), 286 yds, 3 Pass TD, 42 Rush yds, 0 INT
cam ward.camp_buzz_blurb: Ward put on a masterclass in the preseason, showing elite pocket poise, sudden arm angles, and electric scrambling. Tennessee offensive staff opened up the full playbook for Ward in Preseason Week 3, scoring on 4 consecutive drives. Brian Callahan raved about Ward's pre-snap diagnostic speed and arm velocity. ESPN ranks Ward at #222 despite expert consensus placing him at #155 (+67 value diff).
cam ward.draft_strategy: Elite late-round QB2 or Superflex target with Top-12 weekly rushing upside.
cam ward.source: NFL Network Preseason Film & Tennessean Beat

tyrone tracy.name: Tyrone Tracy Jr.
tyrone tracy.preseason_stats: 14 carries, 88 yds (6.3 YPC), 6 rec, 54 yds, 1 TD
tyrone tracy.camp_buzz_blurb: The converted college wide receiver was unstoppable in preseason space. Tracy displayed exceptional lateral agility, contact balance, and natural pass-catching chops out of the backfield. Brian Daboll utilized him heavily in two-minute drill and third-down packages with Daniel Jones. Tracy is pushing Devin Singletary for a 50/50 touch split. ESPN ranks Tracy at #246 vs consensus #165 (+81 value diff).
tyrone tracy.draft_strategy: Smash late-round target in Rounds 11-13; legitimate PPR flex value with RB2 upside.
tyrone tracy.source: New York Daily News & Giants Camp Insider

braelon allen.name: Braelon Allen
braelon allen.preseason_stats: 18 carries, 97 yds (5.4 YPC), 2 TDs, 3 broken tackles
braelon allen.camp_buzz_blurb: At 235 pounds, Allen was a wrecking ball in short-yardage and goal-line packages. The Jets intend to use him as their primary short-yardage hammer to keep Breece Hall fresh, giving Allen standalone touchdown value and RB1 upside if Hall misses any time. Ranked #173 on ESPN.
braelon allen.draft_strategy: Priority bench stash in Rounds 11-12; standalone TD ceiling and tier-1 handcuff.
braelon allen.source: SNY Jets Beat & PFF Rushing Metrics

kimani vidal.name: Kimani Vidal
kimani vidal.preseason_stats: 19 carries, 118 yds (6.2 YPC), 3 rec, 27 yds, 1 TD
kimani vidal.snap_trend: Rotating with 1st Team in Jim Harbaugh Offense 📈
kimani vidal.camp_buzz_blurb: Jim Harbaugh and Greg Roman are notorious for running the ball 30+ times per game, and Vidal was born for this system. He displayed elite low-center-of-gravity contact balance in preseason games, breaking 8 tackles on 19 carries. With veterans J.K. Dobbins and Gus Edwards both managing chronic soft-tissue and knee ailments, Vidal has a clear path to 15+ carries weekly. ESPN ranks him at #215.
kimani vidal.draft_strategy: Must-draft target in the final 3 rounds. Highest upside late-round running back on the board.
kimani vidal.source: The Athletic Chargers Beat & ESPN NFL Nation

jordan whittington.name: Jordan Whittington
jordan whittington.preseason_stats: 16 rec, 184 yds on 21 targets (Led NFL in preseason receptions)
jordan whittington.snap_trend: Target Share Monster & Sean McVay Darling 📈
jordan whittington.camp_buzz_blurb: Whittington was the statistical star of the entire 2026 NFL preseason, leading all players in receptions and yards after catch. Sean McVay called him 'one of the most complete football players I've ever evaluated,' citing his physical run-blocking and tenacity over the middle. With Puka Nacua nursing a week-to-week groin strain and Cooper Kupp's recent injury history, Whittington is lined up for immediate rotational snaps. Left unranked on ESPN's Top 300 cheatsheet.
jordan whittington.draft_strategy: Last-round flyer in 12-team leagues or priority waiver claim Week 1.

ray davis.name: Ray Davis
ray davis.camp_buzz_blurb: Davis impressed the Bills coaching staff with his no-nonsense between-the-tackles downhill running. In Preseason Week 3, Davis scored twice from inside the 5-yard line and hauled in 3 third-down passes from Josh Allen. Buffalo is committed to preserving James Cook by giving Davis 8-12 touches per game, including goal-line work. ESPN ranks him at #238 vs #194.
ray davis.draft_strategy: High-floor standalone flex play with immense touchdown upside.

caleb williams.name: Caleb Williams
caleb williams.preseason_stats: 16/24 (66.7%), 245 yds, 2 Pass TD, 1 Rush TD, 0 INT
caleb williams.camp_buzz_blurb: Williams dazzled in limited preseason action, executing jaw-dropping off-platform completions and a highlight-reel scramble touchdown. Armed with DJ Moore, Keenan Allen, Rome Odunze, and D'Andre Swift, Williams commands the best supporting cast for a #1 overall rookie QB in NFL history. ESPN inexplicably has him ranked at #107 overall while expert consensus places him at #69 (+38 value diff).
caleb williams.draft_strategy: Draft as your starting QB1 in Rounds 7-8 for immediate Top-8 fantasy ceiling.

jonathon brooks.name: Jonathon Brooks
jonathon brooks.preseason_stats: Cleared for Full Contact; 100% sprinting & cutting drills
jonathon brooks.snap_trend: Ramping up for Week 3-4 Workhorse Role 📈
jonathon brooks.camp_buzz_blurb: Brooks has passed all medical hurdles following ACL reconstruction and was seen executing violent cuts during joint practices. Head coach Dave Canales publicly praised Brooks' vision, calling him the engine of Carolina's offense once fully ramped. Chuba Hubbard will start early weeks, but Brooks is expected to commandeer a 65%+ snap share by midseason. Consensus #84 vs ESPN #104 (+20 value diff).
jonathon brooks.draft_strategy: Draft in Rounds 8-9 and stash. Will win fantasy playoff matchups in Weeks 14-17.

isaac guerendo.name: Isaac Guerendo
isaac guerendo.preseason_stats: 12 carries, 86 yds (7.2 YPC), 1 TD on 44-yard sprint
isaac guerendo.snap_trend: Consistently Gashing Defenses in Zone Scheme 📈
isaac guerendo.camp_buzz_blurb: Guerendo boasts an absurd 4.33 40-yard dash at 221 pounds, making him an athletic anomaly in Kyle Shanahan's outside-zone scheme. In Preseason Week 3, he ripped off a 44-yard touchdown run where he reached 21.8 MPH. With Christian McCaffrey dealing with calf and Achilles soreness, Guerendo represents explosive insurance in the NFL's most productive rushing offense. Left unranked on ESPN's official Top 300 cheatsheet despite consensus #318 draft pedigree.
isaac guerendo.draft_strategy: Must-own handcuff for McCaffrey managers; top-end final round dart throw.

dylan sampson.name: Dylan Sampson
dylan sampson.snap_trend: Climbing Up Cleveland Backfield Depth Chart 📈
dylan sampson.camp_buzz_blurb: Sampson showed blazing quickness and jump-cut ability in Browns preseason action. He forced 7 missed tackles on just 15 carries and was utilized as a slot receiver in empty backfield formations. Kevin Stefanski praised his versatility. Ranked #152 on ESPN.
dylan sampson.draft_strategy: Late-round PPR flyer with high weekly floor.

emmett johnson.name: Emmett Johnson
emmett johnson.snap_trend: Working with Patrick Mahomes in 1st-Team 2-Minute Drill 📈
emmett johnson.camp_buzz_blurb: Johnson showed remarkable pass-protection awareness and soft hands catching passes out of the flat from Patrick Mahomes. Andy Reid has a history of unearthing late-round running backs into fantasy starters. ESPN ranks him at #241 vs consensus #173 (+68 value diff).
emmett johnson.draft_strategy: Deep-league stash in PPR and Kansas City offense exposure.

pat bryant.name: Pat Bryant
pat bryant.preseason_stats: 8 rec, 114 yds, 1 TD on 10 targets in preseason action
pat bryant.camp_buzz_blurb: Bryant emerged as Bo Nix's favorite safety valve on intermediate boundary routes. Sean Payton specifically praised Bryant's ability to win 50/50 contested balls in traffic. With Courtland Sutton drawing double coverage, Bryant has clear room to produce. ESPN #263 vs consensus #194 (+69 value diff).
pat bryant.draft_strategy: Sneaky target in Round 14+ for Denver passing volume.

jordyn tyson.name: Jordyn Tyson
jordyn tyson.preseason_stats: 6 rec, 138 yds, 2 TDs (23.0 yards per catch)
jordyn tyson.snap_trend: Primary Field-Tilter in New Klint Kubiak Offense 📈
jordyn tyson.camp_buzz_blurb: Tyson was electrifying in August, hauling in deep touchdowns of 52 and 41 yards. Klint Kubiak's play-action system generates wide open single coverage downfield, and Tyson is the primary beneficiary. Ranked #170 on ESPN.
jordyn tyson.draft_strategy: High-ceiling best-ball and redraft bench weapon.

troy franklin.name: Troy Franklin
troy franklin.preseason_stats: 7 rec, 96 yds, 1 TD; built-in chemistry with Bo Nix
troy franklin.snap_trend: Expanding Route Tree with Starting Unit 📈
troy franklin.camp_buzz_blurb: Franklin's multi-year chemistry with quarterback Bo Nix at Oregon is showing up in NFL game speed. Nix trusts Franklin on timing routes and scramble drill backyard plays. Unranked on ESPN Top 300 vs #241 consensus (+60 value diff).
troy franklin.draft_strategy: Late-round flier with built-in quarterback trust.

keon coleman.name: Keon Coleman
keon coleman.preseason_stats: 8 rec, 102 yds, 1 TD on 12 targets with Josh Allen
keon coleman.camp_buzz_blurb: Coleman has solidified his position as Josh Allen's go-to boundary receiver in contested situations. With Stefon Diggs and Gabe Davis gone, Buffalo has 240+ vacated targets, and Coleman will absorb high-value endzone looks. ESPN lists Coleman at #254.
keon coleman.draft_strategy: Draft for double-digit touchdown potential in Rounds 9-10.

adonai mitchell.name: Adonai Mitchell
adonai mitchell.preseason_stats: 9 rec, 115 yds on 13 targets; 81% win rate vs press man
adonai mitchell.camp_buzz_blurb: Mitchell displayed breathtaking route running in preseason joint practices, generating immediate separation against starting cornerbacks. PFF charted him with an 81% win rate against press man coverage. ESPN #166.
adonai mitchell.draft_strategy: High-upside WR4/WR5 with explosive weekly ceilings.

xavier worthy.name: Xavier Worthy
xavier worthy.preseason_stats: 5 rec, 98 yds, 1 TD, 1 carry for 22 yds
xavier worthy.snap_trend: Designed Touches in Andy Reid Playbook 📈
xavier worthy.camp_buzz_blurb: The NFL combine record holder (4.21 40-yard dash) was weaponized all across the formation by Andy Reid. Kansas City ran end-arounds, tunnel screens, and deep posts for Worthy, creating massive stress on opposing safeties. ESPN #123.
xavier worthy.draft_strategy: Target in Rounds 8-10 as a league-winning ceiling play.

oronde gadsden.name: Oronde Gadsden II
oronde gadsden.preseason_stats: 8 rec, 108 yds, 1 TD on 10 targets in preseason action
oronde gadsden.snap_trend: Lining up in Slot & Boundary Iso 📈
oronde gadsden.camp_buzz_blurb: Gadsden is built like a wide receiver in a tight end's frame (6-foot-5, 236 lbs). Justin Herbert locked onto him on third downs in preseason play, exploiting linebackers and safeties. Gadsden offers true mismatch potential in a Chargers offense with vacated pass targets. Ranked #291 on ESPN.
oronde gadsden.draft_strategy: Top-tier late-round TE streamer with weekly top-6 potential.
oronde gadsden.source: Los Angeles Times & Chargers Camp Beat

audric estime.name: Audric Estime
audric estime.camp_buzz_blurb: A bruising 227-pound runner, Estime converted 4 of 4 short-yardage opportunities in preseason action, punching in 2 touchdowns. He rarely gets tackled for a loss and wears down defensive fronts in the second half. Left unranked on ESPN's Top 300 cheatsheet.
audric estime.draft_strategy: Last-round flier in deep standard scoring leagues.

nicholas singleton.name: Nicholas Singleton
nicholas singleton.preseason_stats: 13 carries, 84 yds (6.5 YPC), 1 TD on 38-yd burst
nicholas singleton.camp_buzz_blurb: Singleton displayed violent acceleration through the line of scrimmage in preseason play, reaching 21.4 MPH on a 38-yard touchdown run against starting defensive units. His home-run capability provides dynamic relief in Tennessee's revamped backfield. ESPN #267 vs consensus #206 (+61 value diff).
nicholas singleton.draft_strategy: Late-round bench flyer with week-winning ceiling.

kaleb johnson.name: Kaleb Johnson
kaleb johnson.preseason_stats: 15 carries, 77 yds, 1 TD; 4.8 YPC after contact
kaleb johnson.camp_buzz_blurb: Johnson proved to be an ideal match for Matt LaFleur's outside-zone rushing attack, displaying patient one-cut vision and physical leg churn. LaFleur commended his pass-protection pickup during two-minute drills. Ranked #266 on ESPN.
kaleb johnson.draft_strategy: Deep sleeper target with direct path to touches.

kaytron allen.name: Kaytron Allen
kaytron allen.preseason_stats: 18 carries, 88 yds (4.9 YPC), 1 TD on goal-line plunge
kaytron allen.camp_buzz_blurb: Allen was impossible to bring down on first contact during Washington's preseason games. Kliff Kingsbury utilized him repeatedly in third-and-short and goal-line scenarios. Ranked #280 on ESPN.
kaytron allen.draft_strategy: Draft in final rounds for guaranteed touchdown upside.

denzel boston.name: Denzel Boston
denzel boston.preseason_stats: 7 rec, 89 yds on 9 targets; 100% catch rate on slant routes
denzel boston.camp_buzz_blurb: Boston quietly had one of the cleanest preseason training camps in Cleveland, securing 7 of 9 targets and displaying strong hands in traffic over the middle. With injuries testing Cleveland's WR depth, Boston has earned situational targets. ESPN #215 vs consensus #153 (+62 value diff).
denzel boston.draft_strategy: Deep sleeper in 14-team and dynasty leagues.
